what: Moving the mouse inside the plate stamps one photo every .2s right at the cursor spot (just dropped in without motion, always on top). From the 8th photo, the oldest disappears in .3s, and any photo left after the cursor has stopped for over .8s also vanishes in .3s. Leaving the plate clears the rest in .3s. The photo set is reused in rotation.

options.stop: Disappears after this many seconds once stopped, default .8
options.length: Number of sheets kept at once, default 8
options.min: Not applied on screens narrower than this width (px), default 992
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photo to display (several — cycled in turn)
options.gap: One photo per this much cursor movement instead of time — px, or add vw like ”6.667vw” for a ratio of window width. If given, every is not used
options.pop: Scales from this multiple up to 1 as it lands and appears (pop-dur seconds, default .2) — if absent it just drops in
options.shrink: When vanishing, shrinks by this multiplier while fading — if empty, it only fades
options.live: 「on」 turns it on as soon as it is attached (when the cursor is already in the panel — toggles on and off by attaching and removing data-fx)

from.where: about.html .ah (company About hero — original about-hero_trail_item · initImageTrail interval 200 · stopDuration 800 · trailLength 8)

index.html end of the Hero intro (.fg-trail) — original trail: each time the pointer moves window width/15, a 21.6×27rem photo lands .8→1 in .2s, and when there are over 5 photos or it pauses 350ms, they shrink to .2× and vanish with .8s expo.out. Off below 1024px.
